description: Show this chat's own whiteboard to the human beside the chat. Name it with title. To reuse another chat's drawing (any folder), pass board.

board.description: Open another chat's board by id or title (this folder first, then any); "own" returns to this chat's

fresh.description: Clear the board first (needed to load saved over a non-empty board)

open.description: Show it to the human if nobody is watching (default true)

saved.description: Load a copy of a saved board (id or name, see canvas_search) into this chat's board

title.description: Name this chat's board after the topic, e.g. "How MCP works"

name: canvas_open
